result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off on the right edge, truncating both the image and the restaurant name text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has proper padding/snapping and that partial cards are either fully hidden or clearly indicate scrollability with a visible affordance (e.g., a peek of ~30-40% of the next card rather than ~10%).

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category filter pill in the horizontal filter row is partially cut off on the right side, and the next filter button is barely visible, making it unclear to users that more options exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible fade/gradient overlay on the right edge of the filter row to signal scrollability, or slightly reduce pill padding so more items are visible and the scroll affordance is clearer.
